description: Schema for the Project Brain produced at Step 7.8. This is the locked design spec that every screen generation call reads. Stored against project_id in the database.

usage_rules.primary: string — when to use primary color

typography.h1: string — font, size, weight, line-height, use case
typography.label: string
typography.caption: string

component_registry.description: Complete CSS definitions for every component in context.product.components. Locked. Every screen generation call receives this as a locked style block.

copy_guide.cta_primary: string — exact CTA label from context.industry.copy.cta
copy_guide.avoid: array — words and patterns to never use

domain_vocabulary.primary_object: string — what the main entity is called

screen_plan.[screen_id]: string — plain English description of what this screen shows and how it's laid out, informed by domain DNA

generation_queue.primary: array of screen_ids — generate first in background
generation_queue.secondary: array of screen_ids — generate after primary
generation_queue.on_demand_features: array of feature_ids — generate only when user navigates there

custom_screens.description: All screens not in the archetype brain. Two sources: (1) custom features with screen_needed=true extracted from notes at Step 1.5b, (2) screens requested post-creation via natural language or broken link detection.

custom_features.description: Custom features extracted from user notes by Step 1.5b. Priority = explicit — same as user-selected checkbox features.

screen_needed_false.handling: note_for_generation added to relevant screens in screen_plan
screen_needed_false.example: screen_plan.checkout += 'Show GST line item. Display tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive amounts.'

screen_needed_true.handling: Added to custom_screens array. generation_priority = primary. Generates in primary batch alongside explicit checkbox features.

visual_dna.description: Visual DNA extracted from user-uploaded inspiration or reference images by Step 1.5v. Only present if user uploaded images on Screen 2. Highest priority visual signal — overrides brain layout defaults. Does not override theme color tokens.
visual_dna.trigger: Only present if user uploaded images on Screen 2
visual_dna.priority: HIGHEST visual signal — overrides brain layout defaults

fields.what_to_replicate: array — applied as positive design direction
fields.generation_notes: string — primary visual direction for generation engine

existing_app_specific.preserve_patterns: array — patterns to keep from existing app

usage.read_by: Step 8 screen generation — one call per screen
usage.not_sent: Raw brain files are NOT sent to screen generation. Project Brain only.
usage.regenerate_when: User edits description or requests a design system refresh
screen_generation_receives: screen_definition (id, priority, purpose, visual, entities, actions, skeleton)

priority_hierarchy.1_explicit: User-selected checkbox features + custom features from notes — HIGHEST — both are direct user intent

priority_hierarchy_visual.1_visual_dna: Uploaded inspiration/reference images — HIGHEST — overrides layout defaults
